S3 version tracking is working, but version switch is not working
# Bug Report

<!--
## Issue name

Issue names must follow the pattern `command: description` where the command is the dvc command that you are trying to run. The description should describe the consequence of the bug.

Example: `repro: doesn't detect input changes`
-->
s3 version tracking with dvc is work, but version switch is not working

## Description

<!--
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
-->
I want to use DVC to manage data versioning in S3 locally without downloading it.
I tried import-url --no-download --version-aware to make sure that the dvc file is versioned.
But I can't switch data between versions with dvc checkout. Even when I do a dvc pull with a specific version of the dvc file, I get the entire s3 data downloaded, not just the file written in the dvc.

### Reproduce

<!--
Step list of how to reproduce the bug
-->
```
git init
dvc init
dvc remote add -d s3 s3://temp/ds/
dvc remote modify s3 version_aware true
mkdir -p data
# Files in s3://temp/ds/dummy : a.text, b.text
dvc import-url --no-download --version-aware s3://temp/ds/dummy data
git add data/dummy.dvc data/.gitignore .dvc/config
git commit -m "version 1"
git tag -a "v1" -m "version 1 tagging"

# Add File in s3://temp/ds/dummy : a.text, b.text, c.text
dvc update --no-download data/dummy.dvc
git add data/dummy.dvc
git commit -m "version 2"
git tag -a "v2" -m "version 2 tagging"
dvc pull

git checkout v1
dvc checkout

# But a.text, b.text, c.text is existed in data/dummy/{} | version 1 only have a.text, b.text

git clean -fdx
dvc gc -w

dvc pull 
# It also download a.text, b.text, c.text  | version 1 only have to download a.text, b.text
```

<!--
Example:

1. dvc init
2. Copy dataset.zip to the directory
3. dvc add dataset.zip
4. dvc run -d dataset.zip -o model ./train.sh
5. modify dataset.zip
6. dvc repro
-->

### Expected

<!--
A clear and concise description of what you expect to happen.
-->
I want to switch data version with dvc checkout.


### Environment information

<!--
This is required to ensure that we can reproduce the bug.
-->

**Output of `dvc doctor`:**

```console
❯ dvc doctor
DVC version: 3.33.3 (pip)
-------------------------
Platform: Python 3.9.18 on macOS-14.1.1-arm64-arm-64bit
Subprojects:
	dvc_data = 2.22.6
	dvc_objects = 1.4.9
	dvc_render = 1.0.0
	dvc_task = 0.3.0
	scmrepo = 1.5.0
Supports:
	http (aiohttp = 3.9.1, aiohttp-retry = 2.8.3),
	https (aiohttp = 3.9.1, aiohttp-retry = 2.8.3),
	s3 (s3fs = 2023.12.1, boto3 = 1.33.1)
Config:
	Global: /Users/a13080/Library/Application Support/dvc
	System: /Library/Application Support/dvc
```

**Additional Information (if any):**

Please check https://github.com/iterative/dvc/wiki/Debugging-DVC on ways to gather more information regarding the issue.

If applicable, please also provide a `--verbose` output of the command, eg: `dvc add --verbose`.
